channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: What Happens When Villages Lead Their Own Change: Inside Swades Foundation’s Community-Led Model of Rural Transformation
item.description: Swades Foundation transforms rural Maharashtra through its 4E model, turning villages into self-reliant Dream Villages with water, health, education, and women's leadership at the core.

item.title: Instagram To Alert Parents If Teens Repeatedly Search Suicide Or Self-Harm Related Content
item.description: Meta’s new Teen Accounts feature will notify parents of repeated suicide-related searches, beginning in four countries before expanding globally in 2026.

item.title: CBI to Move Delhi High Court Against Order Clearing Kejriwal, Sisodia in Excise Policy Case
item.description: After a Delhi trial court discharged Arvind Kejriwal, Manish Sisodia and 21 others citing lack of evidence, the CBI announced it will challenge the ruling in the High Court, extending the high-profile legal battle.

item.title: ‘Dark Side of Braj Ki Holi’: Viral Video Sparks Nationwide Debate On Consent And Women’s Safety
item.description: Viral video from Uttar Pradesh’s Braj sparks outrage, renewing debate on women’s safety and consent during Holi.

item.title: Man Breaks Down After Family Stops His Visit For Holi, Gets Support From Over 6.8 Lakh Internet Users
item.description: A young working man's tearful confession about being barred from coming home for Holi went viral, melting hearts and silent emotional tone borne by India's breadwinners.

item.title: Viral 59-Second Communal Slogan Video Sparks Outrage, Ghaziabad Police Deny Expressway Incident Claim
item.description: Viral clip alleging communal slogan on Delhi–Dehradun Expressway sparked outrage; Ghaziabad Police deny, launch probe.

item.title: Bengaluru Insider Heist: Cashier Allegedly Steals Rs 91 Lakh, Police Recover Rs 81.66 Lakh in 48 Hours
item.description: Two builder’s office employees and associates allegedly stole Rs 91 lakh; police recovered most within two days.

item.title: 15 Killed As Bolivian Air Force Plane Carrying Banknotes Crashes Into Busy El Alto Road
item.description: A Bolivian Air Force C-130 aircraft transporting newly printed banknotes crashed near La Paz amid poor weather, killing 15 and injuring 30 as investigations begin.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders Ban on NCERT Class 8 Textbook; 2.25 Lakh Copies Recalled Nationwide
item.description: NCERT recalls all copies of controversial Class 8 Social Science textbook after Supreme Court ban, urging deletion of shared content.

item.title: Karnataka: Dharwad Teacher Allegedly Takes 80g Gold from Class 10 Student, Boy Attempts Suicide Follows Family’s Complaint
item.description: Class 10 boy attempts suicide after Dharwad teacher allegedly takes 80g of family gold ahead of SSLC exams.
